What is the battery life of the WF-1000XM5?

The WF-1000XM5 offers up to 8 hours of battery life on a single charge, with an additional 24 hours provided by the charging case.

Are the WF-1000XM5 headphones water-resistant?

Yes, the WF-1000XM5 headphones come with an IPX4 rating, making them resistant to splashes from any direction.

Can I use the WF-1000XM5 for phone calls?

Do the WF-1000XM5 support voice assistants?
